name: xt-dev-guardrails
description: xTranslator project-aware development guardrails and verification helpers.

interface.shortDescription: Project-specific verification and IPC sync guardrails for xTranslator.
interface.longDescription: Adds a repo-local skill for xTranslator that turns changed files into the right verification checklist and reminds agents about project-specific invariants like DTO and TypeScript mirror sync, chunked string loading, selectedId-based updates, and Windows Tauri dev startup behavior.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my changed files and tell me which xTranslator checks I must run.
Before editing IPC, remind me which Rust and TypeScript files must stay in sync.
Generate a minimal verification plan for this xTranslator patch.
